title: Chinese SimpleQA: A Chinese Factuality Evaluation for Large Language Models

model.params_source: paper Sec. 4.1 (official / default decoding parameters of each LLM -> OpenAI defaults temperature 1, top_p 1); max_tokens assumed

task.approximation: Judge snapshot gpt-4o-2024-08-06 for the undated GPT-4o (resolution plan); grader template from the release repository (chinese_simpleqa_eval.py GRADER_TEMPLATE), not printed in the paper.

items.config_or_split: chinese_simpleqa.jsonl (3,000 rows verified; fields id, primary_category, secondary_category, question, answer, urls)

prompt.source_location: Sec. 4.1 and Appendix H (question given directly; no system prompt)

placeholders_paper.question: items.input sent directly as the user message under the official chat template (Sec. 4.1, Appendix H)

output.parse_paper: judge grade letter: A correct / B incorrect / C not attempted (GRADER_TEMPLATE)

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: F-score = 2*CO*CGA/(CO+CGA) with CO = correct/3000 and CGA = correct/(correct+incorrect) (Sec. 4.3)
metric.judge: llm:gpt-4o-2024-08-06, prompt GRADER_TEMPLATE in github.com/LivingFutureLab/ChineseSimpleQA chinese_simpleqa_eval.py (SimpleQA grader adapted to Chinese)
metric.original_location: Table 2, row GPT-4-turbo, column F-score (CO 45.6, NA 14.2, IN 40.2, CGA 53.1)

cost.prepare_note: runner --prepare --dry-run 2026-09-07 (chars/4 input tokens, max_tokens counted as output per call)

open_points: judge prompt not printed: the paper gives only the CO/NA/IN definitions (Sec. 4.3) and Appendix H names the judge (GPT-4o, undated); the GRADER_TEMPLATE exists only in the release repository (chinese_simpleqa_eval.py) - the project rule requires the paper's verbatim judge prompt, so a human must approve the repository template (a hook with judge_requests/score_with_judge is then straightforward: gpt-4o-2024-08-06 grades A/B/C, F-score = 2*CO*CGA/(CO+CGA)) and the judge snapshot
notes: Per-topic F-scores in the same row (CC 24.2, HU 55.2, ETAS 58.9, LAC 43.9, SO 52.5, NS 50.8) allow a topic-level check via primary_category. || [normalize 2026-09-07] hf parquet default/train verified (3,000 rows; id, primary_category, secondary_category, question, answer, urls); prompts render with --prepare (the question is the whole user message). || [hooks_3 pass 2026-09-07] no hook until the judge prompt decision is taken.
